title: Study the failures of MKL PARDISO on the Jacobians of Exudyn: the classes of models and the settings for which it is reliable
author: Claude-JG
description: Jacobians exported from ODE models, index-3 and index-2 constrained models and the extreme chain of 1000 rigid bodies on revolute joints, solved by MKL PARDISO through ctypes with the settings varied (two-level factorization, ordering, matching and scaling, pivot perturbation, refinement, numerical noise dropped, the transposed CSC hand-over, threads); the result decides the default parameters of the solver type and for which classes it is recommended (design docs/dev/design/sparseSolvers.md section 3).
releaseNotes: Studied why MKL PARDISO failed on Exudyn's Jacobians: the METIS ordering with the parallel or two-level factorization; the minimum degree ordering with the one-level factorization solves all 18 studied Jacobians (ODE, index 3, index 2, up to 13000 unknowns) on 1-16 threads to the accuracy of SuperLU; these are the defaults of LinearSolverType.PardisoMKL.
